limitations: Scores compare transition endpoint sets per changed requirement. Parallel transitions with identical endpoints can have different triggers, guards or actions and remain indistinguishable to this metric, although their target identities are kept distinct.
The same requirement texts recur across runs; changes are not independent systems.
Appending ' (changed)' tests textual change detection and existing direct trace links, not whether the stated edit requires a semantic model modification.
The expert reference scores direct transition links only. No independent expected dependency-closure labels are available here; closure correctness is not measured.
Strict target validation establishes target existence and endpoint consistency. It does not establish completeness or semantic correctness of the requirement mapping.

protocol.ground_truth_use: scoring only; never used to infer or repair links

metric_definitions.actual_named_targets: actual endpoints of uniquely resolved named targets
metric_definitions.validated_direct_seeds: actual endpoints of targets passing strict trace validation

protocol.prediction_source: each run's own generated trace and actual model

reference.selection_rule: use result_behaviour_model.rct if present; otherwise original result_behaviour.txt
